items.title: ISNA Canada Street Food Festival
items.desc: ISNA Canada's 3rd Annual Street Food Festival. Free admission. Halal street food, entertainment, attractions, vendors, bazaar, activities, contests, inflatables, and performances. Family-friendly community event.

items.title: MWTG Oman Group Trip
items.desc: The Muslim Women's Travel Group presents an 8-day group trip to Oman. Women-only, halal-friendly, small group travel with local guides. Safety, sisterhood, and cultural immersion.

items.title: OnePath Travel Kyrgyzstan (Ladies)
items.desc: Muslim-friendly group trip to Kyrgyzstan for women. Experience breathtaking untouched nature, high mountains, clear blue lakes, and nomadic culture. Small group, halal options, meaningful cultural moments.

items.title: Sakinah Retreats - Cappadocia Turkey
items.desc: 5-day sacred retreat in the surreal landscapes of Cappadocia. Sunrise hot air balloons, ancient caves of Göreme, pottery in Avanos, spiritual day trip to Konya (resting place of Rumi). Faith-aligned travel with sisterhood.

items.title: Sisters Getaway - Morocco
items.desc: Fully-inclusive female-only group trip to Morocco with Sisters Getaway. 15-20 women per group, 2 leaders, private pool, halal meals, airport pickup, yoga, sightseeing, and sisterhood. Split itinerary: rural retreat + city break.

items.title: The Muslim Women's Travel Group: Jordan
items.desc: Group trip to Jordan with The Muslim Women's Travel Group — female-only, fully organized. Not GTA-based, open to join from anywhere.
